description: B-1208 (T-NETWORKING-011, 2026-11-16) positive twin of ready_gate_settings_rollback_smoke. During a real immutable ready gate the remote ordinary client sends its settings again through netClientSettingsChanged and CLC_SETTINGS with nothing changed, as its Room opening (the match setup reset) or a settings menu closing sends them. The authority must keep the prepared roster, publish nothing, and start the match: no rollback, no SVC_MATCH_CANCELLED, both machines in the live stage. Before the fix such a repeat, landing 0.16 s after the gate opened, rolled the gate back and network_coop_mission_end_smoke never started its mission. Port 27218.

required_lines: PLAYER.INIT.COMMIT lobby-start room=\d+ mode=0 players=2 bots=0 manifest=[1-9]\d*
NET: CLC_SETTINGS client=1 repeats its settings during the ready gate; gate kept, nothing published

required_sequences.name: repeat-inside-the-gate-then-launch

input_sequence.comment: The client hook waits internally for the exact PREPARING state and sends one real validated CLC_SETTINGS repeat; each process then waits for its live network stage.
Three seconds of the live stage on both machines, then a scripted exit.
